Enterprise IT-Spezialist mit agilem Mindset und Hands-On Mentalität und Teil der SYZYGY Group.
Mit mehr als 100 Spezialist:innen entwickeln und betreiben wir maßgeschneiderte Softwarelösungen für große Unternehmen wie Continental, Deutsche Bahn, Porsche, Samsung oder Telefonica (o2).
Wir erstellen individuelle Lösungen, die mitdenken. Dabei sind wir hands-on, tech-hungrig, ein wenig nerdy, kommunikativ und echte Teamplayer.
Aktuell suchen wir (vor Ort in Bad Homburg, remote oder teil remote):
Senior .NET Developer (w/m/d)

Du arbeitest gern dort, wo fachliche Anforderungen und technische Komplexität zusammenkommen? Als Senior .NET Developer übersetzt Du beides in belastbare Lösungen für große Enterprise-Projekte.
Dann bist Du bei uns goldrichtig! Wir, SYZYGY Techsolutions – und in Zukunft hoffentlich Du – sind ein in jeder Hinsicht bunter Haufen Nerds.

Aufgaben

Enterprise Webentwicklung

Als Teil eines cross-funktionalen Teams entwickelst Du in großen IT-Projekten moderne Enterprise-Webanwendungen mit .NET (C#). Aktuell arbeiten wir unter anderem mit .NET 10, ASP.NET Core Web API, GraphQL, CI/CD und modernen Cloud-Lösungen.
Architektur und Entwicklungsmethoden

Gemeinsam mit Deinem Team arbeitet Ihr mit modernen Konzepten und Methoden wie SOA, serverless, DDD, TDD und Continuous Delivery.
Agile Zusammenarbeit

Agilität schreiben wir und Du groß. Ihr arbeitet mit agilen Methoden wie beispielsweise Scrum.
Technische Verantwortung

Du bist technische:r Ansprechpartner:in für Dein Team sowie für interne und externe Schnittstellen.
Kundenorientierte Lösungen

Du analysierst Anforderungen, entwickelst gemeinsam mit Deinem Team passgenaue Lösungen und setzt sie im Dialog mit der Kundenseite um.

Profil

In der Webentwicklung mit .NET und .NET Core bringst Du mehrjährige Erfahrung mit.
Backend-Services mit REST oder GraphQL hast Du bereits entwickelt und bereitgestellt.
Mit gängigen Datenbanksystemen wie MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle oder MongoDB kennst Du Dich sehr gut aus.
Erfahrung mit AWS oder Azure ist ein Plus.
Als echter Teamplayer stehst Du Deinem Team jederzeit gerne mit Rat und Tat zur Seite.
Ein offener und klarer Kommunikationsstil sowie sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse runden Dein Profil ab.

Wir bieten

Full remote, Office oder hybrid

Du arbeitest am liebsten im Homeoffice? Du kommst gerne jeden Tag ins Büro? Oder bevorzugst Du die Mischung? Bei uns ist alles möglich. Mit unserer State-of-the-Art Hardware hast Du volle Flexibilität.

Flexible Arbeitszeiten & voller Überstundenausgleich

Morgens mal später anfangen. Oder mal früher in den Feierabend. Kein Problem. Unsere flexiblen Arbeitszeiten machen es möglich. Und sollten doch mal Überstunden anfallen, bekommst Du hierfür den vollen Freizeitausgleich. 

Gehaltspaket

Zusätzlich zum Gehalt bekommst Du optional Zuschüsse zu vermögenswirksamen Leistungen und zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge. Außerdem honorieren wir langjährige, engagierte Mitarbeit in Form einer Sonderzahlung. Und Du profitierst von attraktiven Rabattprogrammen.

Nutze Dein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget, um an Trainings oder Konferenzen teilzunehmen. Gestalte aktiv Deine Entwicklung, wir unterstützen Dich dabei!

jobs.description:
Über Uns

Seit unserer Gründung 1998 ist die QualityHosting auf Microsoft-Technologien für geschäftskritische IT-Anwendungen spezialisiert. Wir sind Microsoft Cloud Solution Provider (CSP) und Deutschlands Marktführer für Hosted Exchange. Unser Unternehmen bietet ein erweitertes Cloud-Portfolio inklusive Microsoft 365, Copilot & AI sowie leistungsfähige CloudServer für Unternehmen jeder Größe an.

Für unser Entwicklungsteam in Frankfurt am Main und Gelnhausen suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen erfahrenen Senior .NET Software Developer (m/w/d)
für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Cloud-Plattform.

Über unsere Web-Anwendungen beziehen und verwalten Kunden und Partner ihre Microsoft-Cloud-Services im Self-Service. Dazu gehören unter anderem:
unser Cloud-Marketplace zum Buchen und Verwalten von Abonnements
Verwaltungsportale für Endkunden und Reseller
Managed Security 365 zum laufenden Schutz von Microsoft-365-Umgebungen
Backend-Prozesse zur automatisierten Bereitstellung und Abrechnung von Microsoft-365-, CSP- und Azure-Diensten

Deine Aufgaben

Du entwickelst rund 50 bis 70 Prozent
deiner Zeit selbst – an den oben genannten Web-Anwendungen und Backend-Prozessen.
Du organisierst und priorisierst die Entwicklungsarbeit und sorgst dafür, dass das Team jederzeit Klarheit darüber hat, welche Themen als Nächstes umgesetzt werden.
Du verantwortest den Backlog und übersetzt Anforderungen aus Support, Account Management und Geschäftsführung in klar definierte und umsetzbare Arbeitspakete.
Du formulierst präzise Specs, mit denen sowohl Entwickler als auch Coding Agents zuverlässig arbeiten können.
Du strukturierst Aufgaben so, dass mehrere Claude-Code-Agenten parallel und möglichst konfliktfrei
arbeiten können, und planst Review-, Test- und Verifikationsschritte von Anfang an mit ein.
Du entwickelst unser technisches Projektgedächtnis aus CLAUDE.md, Claude Skills und MCP-Anbindungen
weiter und machst Wissen für Entwickler und Agents gleichermaßen nutzbar.
Du organisierst die Zusammenarbeit im Team mit leichtgewichtigen Sprints, Refinements und Retrospektiven – pragmatisch und passend zu unserer Teamgröße statt mit unnötigem Prozess-Overhead.
Du koordinierst Releases unserer .NET-Anwendungen und stellst sicher, dass vereinbarte Qualitätsstandards, Tests, Contracts und Definition of Done eingehalten werden.
Du stellst die Qualität der Umsetzung sicher und hinterfragst AI-generierten Code genauso kritisch wie menschlich geschriebenen Code.

Das bringst du mit

Mehrjährige professionelle Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit C# und .NET
, idealerweise an gewachsenen Anwendungen mit anspruchsvoller Fachlogik im produktiven Betrieb.
Praktische Erfahrung mit AI-gestützter bzw. agentischer Softwareentwicklung
, die deutlich über Autocomplete und einzelne Copilot-Vorschläge hinausgeht.
Idealerweise hast du bereits intensiv mit Claude Code
gearbeitet und Erfahrung damit, Specs für Agents zu schreiben, mehrere Agents parallel einzusetzen und Kontext bzw. Projektwissen strukturiert für Agents bereitzustellen.
Erfahrung mit agiler Arbeitsorganisation
, beispielsweise Scrum oder Kanban, sowie mit Priorisierung, Stakeholder-Management und Moderation. Zertifikate wie PSM oder CSM sind willkommen – gelebte Praxis ist uns wichtiger.
Eine ausgeprägte Verifikations- und Qualitätsorientierung: Du verlässt dich weder bei menschlichem noch bei AI-generiertem Code auf den ersten Entwurf, sondern setzt auf Tests, Reviews und Smoke-Checks.
Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.
Hands-on-Mentalität und Entscheidungsfreude. Du hast Lust, in einem kleinen Team mit flachen Hierarchien zwischen eigener Entwicklung, Organisation, Priorisierung und Qualitätssicherung zu wechseln.

Nice-To-Have

Erfahrung mit SaaS- und Self-Service-Anwendungen
, insbesondere Multi-Tenancy und Subscription-Modellen
Erfahrung mit cloud-nativer Architektur auf Azure
, beispielsweise Worker-Patterns, Managed Services und resilienten Architekturen
Claude Skills, MCP-Server oder Automatisierungen
rund um Claude Code
Microsoft-Cloud-Domänenwissen, beispielsweise CSP/Partner Center, Microsoft 365 oder Entra ID

Erfahrung mit CI/CD sowie GitHub Actions und Azure DevOps

Darum lohnt es sich

Arbeiten, wie es zu dir passt
Hybrides Arbeiten ist bei uns keine Ausnahme, sondern Normalität: 2 Tage Home-Office, 3 Tage im Office – so bleibst du flexibel und trotzdem nah am Team.
Ein Job mit Zukunft
Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag bei einem etablierten Cloud-Dienstleister mit Standorten in Frankfurt am Main und Gelnhausen.
Dein Budget, deine Entwicklung
2.000 € Weiterbildungsbudget pro Jahr – für Zertifizierungen, Konferenzen, Bücher oder Coaching. Plus kostenfreie Sprachkurse on top.
Gut abgesichert & fair vergütet
Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, bei der wir deinen Beitrag verdoppeln – plus ein faires Bonussystem on top.
Extras, die sich summieren
Firmenrabatte bei Adidas, Apple, Expedia, home24 und vielen weiteren Partnern – plus 400 € jährliches Budget für unseren QualityHosting-Merch-Shop.

Flache Hierarchien, agile Strukturen und ein herzliches Miteinander – inklusive der Flexibilität, die Familie und Beruf unter einen Hut bringt. Dazu regelmäßige Team-Events und der ein oder andere gemeinsame BBQ-Abend im Sommer.
Dein Standort, deine Wahl
Ruhige Lage in Gelnhausen mit kostenfreiem Parkplatz oder unser modernes Glasbüro in Frankfurt mit JobTicket-Übernahme – du entscheidest.

About The Company

Scheidt & Bachmann GmbH is a renowned leader in developing innovative and sustainable mobility infrastructure systems. With a history spanning over 150 years, the company plays a vital role in the transportation sector, providing solutions for railway systems, parking management, fueling stations, charging infrastructure, and public transportation. Beratung

Als Expert:in für AI & Cloud entwickelst du maßgeschneiderte End-to-End-Lösungen - von der Cloud-Zielarchitektur über Data & AI Platforms bis hin zu produktiven Machine-Learning- und Generative-AI-Anwendungen - die den individuellen Anforderungen der Kunden entsprechen. Mit einem tiefen Verständnis moderner Cloud- und AI-Technologien und einem klaren Fokus auf Business Value trägst du dazu bei, dass Kunden ihre Transformation sicher, effizient und zukunftsfähig gestalten.
Projektarbeit
– Du begleitest Kunden in allen Phasen eines Transformationsprojekts - von der Anforderungsaufnahme über Architekturdesign und Technologieauswahl bis hin zu Implementierung, Deployment und Skalierung - und übernimmst je nach Erfahrung eine leitende Rolle. Zusammen mit deinem Team entwickelst du Lösungen in den Bereichen Cloud-Migration, Data & AI Platforms, MLOps, Generative AI und AI Governance, um Innovationskraft zu steigern, Prozesse zu automatisieren und neue datengetriebene Geschäftsmodelle zu ermöglichen.
Entwicklung
– Du arbeitest in einem motivierten Team, übernimmst Verantwortung und unterstützt Kunden und Kollegen, während du mit verschiedenen Branchen in Kontakt kommst, eigenverantwortlich Themen erarbeitest und die agile Projektpraxis kennenlernst. Mit zunehmender Erfahrung coachst du jüngere Kolleg:innen, gestaltest den Ausbau unseres AI & Cloud-Portfolios aktiv mit und übernimmst Verantwortung in Business Development, Angebotserstellung und Kundenakquise.

Das bringst du mit
Du hast dein Studium in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, Mathematik, Physik oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich überdurchschnittlich abgeschlossen und mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Umfeld Cloud, Data & AI gesammelt.
Du verfügst über fundierte Erfahrung im Design und in der Implementierung von Cloud-Architekturen auf mindestens einer der führenden Hyperscaler-Plattformen (Azure, AWS oder GCP) und hast praktische Erfahrung mit Data & AI Services wie Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI, Databricks, Snowflake oder Microsoft Fabric. Idealerweise bringst du entsprechende Zertifizierungen (z. B. Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Solutions Architect, GCP Professional Cloud Architect) mit.
Du hast fundierte Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Umsetzung von AI- und Machine-Learning-Lösungen - von klassischem ML über Deep Learning bis hin zu Generative AI (LLMs, RAG-Architekturen, Agentic AI) - sowie in den Bereichen MLOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Bicep) und Container-Technologien (Docker, Kubernetes).
Du weißt, wie man komplexe technische Konzepte in verständliche Handlungsempfehlungen für Fach- und C-Level-Stakeholder übersetzt. Kenntnisse in Python, SQL sowie ein solides Verständnis für AI Governance, Responsible AI, Datenschutz (DSGVO) und den EU AI Act helfen dir, ganzheitliche und zukunftsfähige Lösungen zu gestalten.

Deine Benefits
Flexibilität
– In Abstimmung mit deinem Team erwartet dich ein Mix aus gemeinsamen Bürotagen und Home Office. Dabei gibt es keine Kernarbeitszeiten – im Rahmen der betrieblichen Anforderungen und arbeitsrechtlichen Vorgaben kannst du deine Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten. Zusätzlich hast du die Möglichkeit, temporär in über 40 Ländern zu arbeiten.

Freizeit
– Überstunden kannst du auf deinem Jahresarbeitszeitenkonto (JAZ) sammeln und nach arbeitsintensiven Phasen durch Freizeit ausgleichen. Restliche Überstunden werden einmal jährlich ausgezahlt. Zusätzlich stehen dir 30 Urlaubstage im Kalenderjahr zur Verfügung.

jobs.title: Application Developer
jobs.description:
NAPA Design Solutions offers a comprehensive solution for 3D ship modeling and design tools covering hull form design and hydrodynamics, hydrostatics and stability, structural design, and information sharing across the shipbuilding process. These are among the most powerful tools in the industry, trusted by the world's largest shipyards and classification societies.

The role: what is it about?

The team is now looking for a Software Developer who will focus on application usability development with .NET, C#, WPF and XAML. Development, testing, and maintenance of the NAPA ship design solutions are part of your daily work. In this role you will mainly work on developing NAPA Engineer , a modern design and computing platform for naval architects. It combines trusted NAPA calculation capabilities with a redesigned, intuitive user experience and a powerful visual approach to engineering workflows. You can read more about the solution at: https://www.napa.fi/software-and-services/ship-design/software/napa-engineer/

You will do this work with artificial intelligence (AI) as a normal part of your toolchain. We use agentic coding capability across our development teams, which means using AI coding agents to plan, write, test, review and refactor code, and doing it in a way that improves both delivery speed and code quality. We expect you to use these tools in your daily work, to help us learn where they work well and where they do not, and to share those learnings with your team.

You will be working with Windows desktop applications, native libraries, third-party components, including a 3D graphics library, database engines, a licensing solution, and more
.
This job is permanent and full-time
.

Your team and job location

You will work in an international team where your closest colleagues are experienced software developers and naval architectural domain experts who will support you in your role. You will also interact with local and global colleagues
from various teams in software development, UX design, DevOps, and sales. Together with them you will also shape how we use AI coding agents in practice, from tooling choices to review practices.

Our office is located in Helsinki (Ruoholahti), and you can work at the office or in hybrid mode
.
We hope to meet you at our Helsinki office regularly. We require you to be eligible to work in Finland.

What are we looking for?

What matters most: you're curious about UI development, energized by AI-assisted development tools, and hungry to solve real problems as a self-starter
. If the visual side of UI excites you too, that's a big plus.

Our ideal candidate would have:

Academic degree in a relevant field such as computer science, mathematics, physics, naval architecture, or engineering
Completed basic studies and/or having a good understanding of algorithms, data structures, and OOP (object-oriented programming)
2+ years of experience in building native Windows desktop applications
Experience in UI design
Experience using WPF, C#, and XAML
Understanding of user experience and the ability to apply it in your own design work
Hands-on experience of using AI coding assistants or coding agents in real development work, together with the judgment to review, test and take responsibility for what they produce
Interest in NAPA’s domain (maritime business)

Additionally, the following skills would be considered an advantage:

Experience with agentic coding workflows
Knowledge or studies in usability
Experience with database solutions
Experience in automated testing methods
Knowledge of software reliability and maintainability
Experience in CAD or CAE applications

You do not need to tick every box on these lists. If this role feels like a good fit for you and you have most of what we are looking for, we hope you will apply.

We work in English
across all our offices, so you need to be comfortable using it in your daily work, both in writing and in conversation.

Why you will enjoy working in this role

You get to combine modern desktop application development on a next-generation engineering platform, combined with AI agentic development that we are scaling across the company
The design work of the world's largest shipyards and classification societies happens in the software you develop
Great colleagues with expertise in, for example, naval architecture, software development and UX design
A global team of 230 experts who support you and share what they know
When you join NAPA, you will be assigned an onboarding buddy who will help ensure a smooth start and introduce you to the NAPA way of working

Ready to get on board and join the napa crew?

We kindly ask you to send your application and CV to us as soon as possible (by clicking the "Apply for this job" button on the job ad page), but no later than 11 October 2026
. The position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate has been found.

For more information about the position, please send your questions by e-mail to jobs@napa.fi . Notice that we cannot accept job applications sent by e-mail.

NAPA as a company and as an employer

With over 35 years of operation, NAPA is a leading software and data services provider for ship design and operations to enable safe, sustainable, and future-proof maritime industry. Headquartered in Finland, NAPA employs 230 experts, combining expertise in naval architecture, fleet operations and digital services. NAPA operates globally, with a presence in Japan, Korea, China, Singapore, the USA, Germany, Greece, Romania and India.

With over 90% of new vessels built by NAPA customers, NAPA’s ship design software is the global de facto standard in shipbuilding. Furthermore, NAPA is a market leader in ship stability management and safety data services for passenger ships, and its cloud-based solutions for ship performance monitoring and voyage optimization support shipping’s decarbonization journey. For more information, visit www.napa.fi .

Meaningful work

We are proud to play our part in creating a sustainable world, and a career at NAPA means working with a purpose. We focus on building the best possible products for our customers, with whom we have close and long-lasting relationships. We protect the environment and human life at sea by powering safer and greener vessels with our technology.

NAPA way of working

At NAPA, we lead and manage the company together. We help and learn from each other, while making impactful decisions for a cleaner, safer maritime industry.
At its heart, our co-leadership philosophy is founded on trust. We trust that our people are smart enough that if they make a decision, having consulted the right people, it will be good for our company. And if it's not the right decision on that occasion, that's fine too. We trust that we'll make it right, learn from the decision, and grow as a company as a result.

Enjoy working together

...is one of our core values. Learning from and respecting each other provides a healthy and pleasant working environment. We, as NAPArians, share our knowledge and help each other when needed. NAPA has offices and customers around the world, and you will be able to meet people from many different cultures. We are a diverse team with a shared goal.
Read more about our values and culture: https://www.napa.fi/careers/

Accountable for feature execution end-to-end.
A key technical sparring partner within the team, providing high-level feedback during code reviews and helping troubleshoot deep-seated technical issues.
Collaborating across Engineering, Product, and Design to shape feature implementations and proactively resolve structural technical debt in our integration logic.
A supportive team member and mentor. Continuous learning and knowledge-sharing are in your DNA, as you help onboard new engineers, support less senior colleagues, and iterate to build creative business solutions.

Who is the Connect Team?

The Connect Team bridges Formalize with our customers' broader tech ecosystems. We build and maintain our public APIs, design complex integration patterns, and engineer event-driven, logic-heavy workflows for seamless data exchange.

In doing so, we turn Formalize from a standalone software service into foundational compliance infrastructure, making compliance effortless across any tech stack and driving our vision to become Europe’s leading GRC platform.

Our tech stack:

PHP with Laravel
Angular 22
TailwindCSS
PostgreSQL
Redis for caching
Claude Code
Serverless infrastructure on AWS

What you’ll bring:

Although we see ourselves as tech-agnostic, you ideally bring experience in at least one layer of our technical stack (we work with PHP and Angular), as well as general software architecture and system design.
Demonstrated senior experience in a Software Engineering role, designing, building, and maintaining highly scalable systems in production, end-to-end.
Experience in product development with a focus on quality, balancing business needs against scope creep to build features that directly move the product forward.
Good engineering practices for testing, deployment, & observability.
The ability to communicate trade-offs clearly, providing high-level feedback to colleagues and participating effectively in technical discovery.
The ability to raise the bar for engineering quality and performance through reference implementations and by defining ever-evolving code standards.

We offer you:

A starting salary of 62,000 DKK per month. As you grow within this role, your compensation can grow with you up to 72,000 DKK per month.
Continuous development through a clear and transparent framework, so you always know what the next step looks like through bi-annual growth talks and regular check-ins.
Thorough pre-boarding and onboarding to set you up for success.
An office-first culture in a centrally located office near Kødbyen, along with visa support if needed.
A culture of ownership, trust, and independence with the support you need.
A strong team spirit where we celebrate wins and enjoy time together across offices.
Our annual Global Summit, where the whole company connects over strategic achievements and projects.

Our recruitment process:

Send your application and upload relevant information.
30-minute online interview with our Talent Acquisition team.
30-minute online interview with the Hiring Manager.
Completion of Personality Assessment & 1h Technical Assessment.
A collaborative no-coding session where we work through building a real feature in Formalize: clarifying requirements, data modelling, and walking through pseudo-code together

30-minute walkthrough of our career framework and offer details.
60-minute in-person interview to meet the team.

About Formalize:

Formalize is a tech company founded in 2021 with offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Milan, Madrid, Munich & Paris. Currently, we are a team of +200 people from +30 nationalities operating in multiple European markets and are one of the fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups. We thrive on ambition, deliver impact through pragmatism, and embrace passion and honesty. We celebrate our wins, learn from our mistakes, and grow together as a team.

Our journey began in the whistleblowing compliance sector, highlighted by the award-winning Whistleblower Software by Formalize, which laid the foundation for our success story. Now, we have extended our expertise to a larger compliance universe, including data compliance, risk, and privacy.

Our Formalize product helps companies to effortlessly navigate and stay ahead in the ever-changing landscape of compliance. Our platform adapts to regulatory changes, continuously adapting to meet and foresee the evolving needs of our users, ensuring businesses remain compliant and confident in their operations.

Still curious? Read more about us here: About Formalize.

Ready to apply?

We interview on an ongoing basis and hire when the right person is found.

For more information or questions, please contact the listed recruiter at the bottom of the job page. Otherwise, apply with your resume and relevant information through our Career Page. We look forward to your application!

Our primary development is in Rust, and you'll also work with and support C#/.NET components where appropriate.

Innovate and Enhance: Design and build Rust-based, multithreaded, high-volume trade flow processing systems.

Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in a formal enterprise-level development environment.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS

Agile Development: Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies and best practices.
Test-Driven Development: Experience with behavior-driven and test-driven development approaches; exposure to Rust testing frameworks such as proptest or quickcheck would be advantageous.
Full-Stack Development: Working knowledge of modern web and mobile development frameworks, including React.js and Angular.
Financial Markets Knowledge: Understanding of the FIX protocol and Microsoft SQL Server, along with familiarity with U.S. and international equities, fixed income, and commodity markets.
Post-Trade Lifecycle: Awareness of post-trade lifecycle processes and related operational workflows.

WHY JOIN US

Meaningful Impact: Play a key role in building and enhancing critical systems that support our trading operations.
Career Development: Broaden your exposure to the business and operational aspects of trading and post-trade processing.
Collaborative Culture: Join a high-performing, supportive team that values innovation, partnership, and continuous improvement.

Mimari ve Geliştirme: B2B ve B2C servislerinin bir arada çalıştığı, ölçeklenebilir ve yüksek performanslı backend mimarisini tasarlamak ve bizzat geliştirmek.
Teknik Standartlar: Proje genelinde "Best Practices" standartlarını uygulamak, yüksek kaliteli kod yazımını sağlamak ve kod incelemeleri (Code Review) ile teknik sürdürülebilirliği korumak.

Problem Çözme: Karmaşık sistem hatalarını analiz ederek kalıcı çözümler üretmek ve performans darboğazlarını gidermek.
Deployment Yönetimi: Yeni sürümlerin ve güncellemelerin sistem genelinde pürüzsüz bir şekilde yayına alınması süreçlerinde aktif rol almak.

Aradığımız Nitelikler

Eğitim: Bilgisayar Mühendisliği veya ilgili alanlarda lisans derecesi.
Deneyim: Çevik (Agile) ortamlarda, üretim seviyesinde (production-ready) backend geliştirme konusunda en az 5-6 yıl deneyim.

Versiyon Kontrolü: Git akışları (branching, merging strategies) konusunda tam hakimiyet.

Event-Driven: Olay güdümlü sistemler ve asenkron mimariler üzerine çalışma geçmişi.
English Proficiency & Academic Background: İyi seviyede İngilizce bilgisine sahip, tercihen Bilgisayar Mühendisliği, Yazılım Mühendisliği, Matematik veya ilgili bölümlerden, saygın üniversitelerden mezun.

new_jobs.title: Application Developer
new_jobs.description:
NAPA Design Solutions offers a comprehensive solution for 3D ship modeling and design tools covering hull form design and hydrodynamics, hydrostatics and stability, structural design, and information sharing across the shipbuilding process. These are among the most powerful tools in the industry, trusted by the world's largest shipyards and classification societies.

The role: what is it about?

The team is now looking for a Software Developer who will focus on application usability development with .NET, C#, WPF and XAML. Development, testing, and maintenance of the NAPA ship design solutions are part of your daily work. In this role you will mainly work on developing NAPA Engineer , a modern design and computing platform for naval architects. It combines trusted NAPA calculation capabilities with a redesigned, intuitive user experience and a powerful visual approach to engineering workflows. You can read more about the solution at: https://www.napa.fi/software-and-services/ship-design/software/napa-engineer/

You will do this work with artificial intelligence (AI) as a normal part of your toolchain. We use agentic coding capability across our development teams, which means using AI coding agents to plan, write, test, review and refactor code, and doing it in a way that improves both delivery speed and code quality. We expect you to use these tools in your daily work, to help us learn where they work well and where they do not, and to share those learnings with your team.

You will be working with Windows desktop applications, native libraries, third-party components, including a 3D graphics library, database engines, a licensing solution, and more
.
This job is permanent and full-time
.

Your team and job location

You will work in an international team where your closest colleagues are experienced software developers and naval architectural domain experts who will support you in your role. You will also interact with local and global colleagues
from various teams in software development, UX design, DevOps, and sales. Together with them you will also shape how we use AI coding agents in practice, from tooling choices to review practices.

Our office is located in Helsinki (Ruoholahti), and you can work at the office or in hybrid mode
.
We hope to meet you at our Helsinki office regularly. We require you to be eligible to work in Finland.

What are we looking for?

What matters most: you're curious about UI development, energized by AI-assisted development tools, and hungry to solve real problems as a self-starter
. If the visual side of UI excites you too, that's a big plus.

Our ideal candidate would have:

Academic degree in a relevant field such as computer science, mathematics, physics, naval architecture, or engineering
Completed basic studies and/or having a good understanding of algorithms, data structures, and OOP (object-oriented programming)
2+ years of experience in building native Windows desktop applications
Experience in UI design
Experience using WPF, C#, and XAML
Understanding of user experience and the ability to apply it in your own design work
Hands-on experience of using AI coding assistants or coding agents in real development work, together with the judgment to review, test and take responsibility for what they produce
Interest in NAPA’s domain (maritime business)

Additionally, the following skills would be considered an advantage:

Experience with agentic coding workflows
Knowledge or studies in usability
Experience with database solutions
Experience in automated testing methods
Knowledge of software reliability and maintainability
Experience in CAD or CAE applications

You do not need to tick every box on these lists. If this role feels like a good fit for you and you have most of what we are looking for, we hope you will apply.

We work in English
across all our offices, so you need to be comfortable using it in your daily work, both in writing and in conversation.

Why you will enjoy working in this role

You get to combine modern desktop application development on a next-generation engineering platform, combined with AI agentic development that we are scaling across the company
The design work of the world's largest shipyards and classification societies happens in the software you develop
Great colleagues with expertise in, for example, naval architecture, software development and UX design
A global team of 230 experts who support you and share what they know
When you join NAPA, you will be assigned an onboarding buddy who will help ensure a smooth start and introduce you to the NAPA way of working

Ready to get on board and join the napa crew?

We kindly ask you to send your application and CV to us as soon as possible (by clicking the "Apply for this job" button on the job ad page), but no later than 11 October 2026
. The position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate has been found.

For more information about the position, please send your questions by e-mail to jobs@napa.fi . Notice that we cannot accept job applications sent by e-mail.

NAPA as a company and as an employer

With over 35 years of operation, NAPA is a leading software and data services provider for ship design and operations to enable safe, sustainable, and future-proof maritime industry. Headquartered in Finland, NAPA employs 230 experts, combining expertise in naval architecture, fleet operations and digital services. NAPA operates globally, with a presence in Japan, Korea, China, Singapore, the USA, Germany, Greece, Romania and India.

With over 90% of new vessels built by NAPA customers, NAPA’s ship design software is the global de facto standard in shipbuilding. Furthermore, NAPA is a market leader in ship stability management and safety data services for passenger ships, and its cloud-based solutions for ship performance monitoring and voyage optimization support shipping’s decarbonization journey. For more information, visit www.napa.fi .

Meaningful work

We are proud to play our part in creating a sustainable world, and a career at NAPA means working with a purpose. We focus on building the best possible products for our customers, with whom we have close and long-lasting relationships. We protect the environment and human life at sea by powering safer and greener vessels with our technology.

NAPA way of working

At NAPA, we lead and manage the company together. We help and learn from each other, while making impactful decisions for a cleaner, safer maritime industry.
At its heart, our co-leadership philosophy is founded on trust. We trust that our people are smart enough that if they make a decision, having consulted the right people, it will be good for our company. And if it's not the right decision on that occasion, that's fine too. We trust that we'll make it right, learn from the decision, and grow as a company as a result.

Enjoy working together

...is one of our core values. Learning from and respecting each other provides a healthy and pleasant working environment. We, as NAPArians, share our knowledge and help each other when needed. NAPA has offices and customers around the world, and you will be able to meet people from many different cultures. We are a diverse team with a shared goal.
Read more about our values and culture: https://www.napa.fi/careers/

new_jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (AI)
new_jobs.description:
Our partner develops and operates supply chain collaboration platforms for the automotive, manufacturing, and aerospace industries.
Tasks
Develop and maintain scalable cloud-based applications using C#, .NET, Entity Framework Core, and REST APIs
Build modern frontend solutions using React and TypeScript
Develop AI-driven services and intelligent workflows using Python and C#
Design, build and integrate AI agents into enterprise applications
Use modern AI development tools such as Claude, Cursor and Copilot in your daily work
Design AI architectures, including agent orchestration, context management and optimization
Collaborate with engineering teams to introduce and improve AI-powered solutions
Contribute to cloud-based application development in a modern C#/.NET environment

Requirements
4+ years of software development experience
Strong backend knowledge with C#/.NET, EF Core, and REST APIs
Solid frontend experience with React and TypeScript (React experience is mandatory)
Strong programming skills in at least two core technologies, preferably Python and C#
Experience building AI workflows and agent-based solutions
Hands-on experience with AI development tools such as Claude, Cursor and Copilot
Strong knowledge of several of the following: Prompt engineering, AI agents, MCP architecture, EVALs, Guardrails, Context optimization
Experience with Microsoft Azure is an advantage
Fluent English

Benefits
Hybrid working model with 2 days of home office per week
Health insurance and cafeteria benefits
Flexible working hours
High level of autonomy and creative freedom
Continuous professional development opportunities
Supportive leadership culture and international working environment
Opportunity to work with modern technologies and AI-driven solutions
